out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. The 2025 health department permit was posted but the 2026 permit was not.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. Please request a copy of the 2026 permit and post it as soon as it’s received. Correct before the next routine inspection not to exceed six months.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. There were no paper towels provided at the handwashing sink next to the dishwasher.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. The PIC corrected this during the inspection.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. There was no “employees must watch hands” sign two hand sinks. One behind the bar and one in the dishwasher area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. The EHS provided one sign and the PIC provided the second sign.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: raw beef patties and grape leaves were not being held a proper temperatures in the three door table. Top refrigerator. The beef patties were 44° and the grape leaves were 45°. Cut lettuce (x2) and sliced tomatoes were not cold enough on the cold rail at 56º, 57º, and 55º
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The PIC moved both products to the walk-in refrigerator to cool them down. The PIC discarded the out of temperature lettuce and tomatoes.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Labeled bottle containing blue liquid next to the cooking area. This was a cleaning solution.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. The PIC labeled the solution during the inspection to correct. Please ensure that all secondary containers of cleaning solutions are labeled at all times.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The expired 2025 health department permit is posted, not the current 2026 permit.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. Please locate and post the 2026 permit as soon as possible or within 90 days.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed a knife and other utensil stored in the hand sink on the main prep line.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. The PIC moved the utensils. CDI.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw beef kabobs stored over prepared kataifi product.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitizing, Contact Time Met
violations.observation: Observed the chlorine sanitizer level of the warewashing machine was below 50 ppm.
violations.corrective_action: The PIC primed the pump. The sanitizer level was 100 ppm chlorine before the inspection ended. CDI. NAJA (Inspection Date: 03/25/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: mashed potatoes in the Alto Shaam were 110ºF.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. The PIC had the product reheated to 135º. CDI.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: hummus on an ice bath was 52º; roasted tomatoes were 82º on the prep table; in the three door table top “dips unit”, hummus was 54º, taziki was 54º, carrot dip was 54º, and walnut dip was 55º. This unit needs service as its ambient temperature was 46º.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The hummus was discarded (make sure the ice bath surrounds the container the food is in, not just sits on top of the ice). The roasted tomatoes were discarded. All items in the dips unit were out of temperature for more than 4 hours and were discarded. CDI. Please notify your EHS when the unit has been serviced.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The warewashing machine final sanitizer concentration was 0 ppm, so no equipment or utensils were being properly sanitized after being washed and rinsed.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. The manager corrected the sanitizer issue and had the food employee rewash all equipment.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cut lettuce on the True 1- door refrigerator, and cut lettuce on an ice bath on the True two-door salad prep unit were out of temperature at 45 and 47°F. Cut tomatoes on an ice bath were 47°F on the two door unit.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The manager discussed using time only as a public health control for these items. However, there is no documentation for this agreement. The EHS provided the manager with a copy of the time only as a public health control agreement which the manager will fill out and send back. The foods were discarded. NAJA (Inspection Date: 09/26/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: Lebanese chicken wing sauce expired on 9/16/25, but was still in storage in the walk-in.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. The food employee discarded the product.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: the staff were date working items prepared on site. However, there are some items that were not date marked.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. Be sure that all items prepared on site and held for more than 24 hours are date marked. It is recommended that the date fee and expiration date, which would be six days from the date it was prepared. Any items exceeding expiration date on the label must be discarded. The EHS discussed this requirement with the leadership team and they corrected it on site by discussing it with food employees.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: bowls and containers without handles are being used to dispense ice and other foods, which can lead to bare hand contact with foods.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Please use handle utensils to dispense all foods and keep the handles out of the food. Correct before the next routine inspection.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Availability of Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There are no chemical sanitizers for sanitizing equipment and utensils available in the establishment. The sanitize concentration at the washing machine was 0 parts per million chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: Except for those that are generated on-site, at the time of use, chemical sanitizers that are used to sanitize equipment and utensils shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. The manager changed the sanitizer bucket which corrected this issue.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed ceiling panels out of place. Observed the light over the warewashing machine was not working.
violations.corrective_action: Replace the ceiling panels to prevent pest entry before the next routine inspection. Repair the light fixture before the next routine inspection.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at the handwashing sink at the entry of kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC placed soap at the sink.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: raw ground beef stored above whole muscle intact beef.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). PIC rearranged raw meet products according to different cooking temperatures.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: dicing blade at prep sink.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. PIC cleaned blade thoroughly.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: garlic sauce in ice bath on the counter at serve station (68F), cut cabbage in ice bath on 3 DR flat-top (48F).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded garlic sauce. PIC moved cut cabbage to cooler.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: Observed kale salad (02/24) stored in WIC for more than seven days.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC discarded aforementioned food items.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Linens & Napkins, Proper Use
violations.observation: Linens (towels) found used in direct contact with the following food item(s): cilantro in the containers in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Linens may not be used in contact with food unless they are used to line a container for the service of foods and the linens are replaced each time the container is refilled for a new consumer. PIC removed towels from containers and washed cilantro.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed scoop handle in the ice machine stored in direct contact with ice.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC placed the scoop in designated area.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. Observed the test kit for Quaternary ammonia is missing.
violations.corrective_action: PIC ordered Quarterly ammonia test kit during inspection.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Design/Install per Law
violations.observation: The plumbing system serving this food service facility has not been designed, constructed, and installed according to the Plumbing Code. Observed not approved splitter attached to the faucet of mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be designed, constructed, and installed according to Law. PIC disconnected splitter from the faucet.
